headline: NYY @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.67 at BAL 3.43, with a projected total of 8.10. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: NYY moved -1.72 runs while BAL moved -0.36, changing the projected margin by -1.36 runs. The projected total fell -2.08, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +12.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Will Warren has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Samuel Basallo, Cody Bellinger, Aaron Judge, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Taylor Ward, Austin Wells because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
